PK = Primary Key · FK = Foreign Key · SCD2 = Slowly Changing Dimension Type 2
SCD Type 2 dimensions maintain full history with scd2_effective_date, scd2_expiry_date, and is_current_flag columns
All surrogate keys (_sk) are BIGINT generated by Databricks Delta · Business keys (BK) are the natural source-system identifiers
